findings.explanation: Lean’s `else 0` proves that every infinite set has cardinality zero, including `UNIV : Set Nat`. HOL4’s `CARD_DEF` specifies the value on `EMPTY` and the result of inserting an element into a finite set. Assigning cardinality one to the natural-number universe satisfies those same equations.
findings.repair:
opaque cardOnInfinite {α : Type u} (s : Set α) : Nat

def CARD {α : Type u} (s : Set α) : Nat :=
  if FINITE s then
    Classical.epsilon (fun n : Nat => ∃ l : List α, l.Nodup ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ l ↔ s x) ∧ l.length = n)
  else cardOnInfinite s
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.Basic

example {α : Type} (s : Set α) (h : ¬ FINITE s) : CARD s = 0 := by
  classical
  simp [CARD, h]
findings.hol4_check: ?c : num set -> num. c UNIV = 1 /\ c EMPTY = 0 /\ (!s. FINITE s ==> !x. c (x INSERT s) = (if x IN s then c s else SUC (c s)))
